questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: We should first have the OLA accepted, then we should create our own UNIMIA profile and register through a very old school website. Found this part quite difficult. Then, we should go physically into an office and get our stamps/studycard.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Massimo Costa was availabe on email.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: My case is not representative as we registered way to late due to misunderstandings.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: go together with someone else in this process so you make sure you dont miss anything :)

choose housing within the 'circle'
bring more money than you think

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: one thing: in italy it is possible to take courses both attendning and non-attending so dont stress if the courses you want is overlapping in schedule, you can easily take one of the courses attending (showing up in class) and the other one non-attending
